title: Employee Handbook
canonical:
# Employee Handbook

This handbook explains how leave, benefits and equipment work at ACME.

## 1 Leave

Every full-time employee receives annual leave. Apply through the HR portal.

- Apply at least three days ahead.
  - Your manager approves the request.
- Unused days carry over until March.

Leave entitlements

| Leave type | Days | Paid |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Annual | 12 | Yes |
| Sick | 30 |  |
| Unpaid leave by agreement |  | No |

### 1.1 Sick leave

Sick leave needs a doctor's note after two days.

Steps to request leave:

1. Open the portal.
2. Choose the dates.
  2.a) Half days are allowed.
3. Submit.

## 2 Phúc lợi

Nhân viên được hỗ trợ ăn trưa và gửi xe. Mức hỗ trợ cập nhật hằng năm.

#### 2.1 Thiết bị

Each employee gets a laptop.

Organisation chart of the HR team

A boxed note: policies are reviewed every January.

```
curl -X POST https://hr.example/api/leave
```

Part-time staff receive leave pro rata.
